name: Sendou Mahiro
source: A patron of "YuKuRu" and an old friend of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She used to be co-workers with Shin at the chain restaurant "Ressac,' but now she works as an rookie camerawoman. She can be boyish and lack delicacy in her speech, but she's earnest and passionate about the things that matter to her most. Her friendship with Shin leaves no reservations between them, which is rare among Shin's female acquaintances. [spoiler]This aspect can backfire as it was the trigger for the big argument between Shin and [url=/c66132]Kyouko[/url] in the Other Side route. [/spoiler]
